howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB. Each page renders as a thumbnail.

howto.name: Drag and rearrange
howto.text: Reorder, rotate, or delete pages visually. Use Duplicate to repeat a page.

howto.name: Apply and download
howto.text: Click Save. The output PDF has pages in your specified order.

faq.q: Can I rotate individual pages independently?
faq.a: Yes — each thumbnail has its own rotate button. Rotations are 90° clockwise / counter-clockwise / 180°.

faq.q: How is this different from Extract Pages?
faq.a: Extract keeps a subset in original order. Organize lets you reorder, duplicate, rotate, and delete all in one pass.
Bookmarks targeting deleted pages are removed; targeting reordered pages, they follow to the new position.
